classification.difficultyReason: Use the explicitly requested obtuse branch after inverse sine.

spec.description: Shallow triangle with lower-left vertex, upper central vertex and right vertex. Upper-right side 6 km; long lower side 9 km. Obtuse θ at upper central vertex with arc. Small left angle marked with arc and an external 21° label below, with leader arrow pointing into its sector.
spec.mathematics: sin θ / 9 = sin 21° / 6; θ is obtuse. Dark-blue edges #253F8E; black labels, arcs and leader. Source proportions retained rather than asserting a scale drawing.

spec.description: Lower-left, upper-left-of-centre and rightmost vertices. Upper-to-right side 36 cm; lower-left-to-right side 52 cm. Interior 34° at lower-left and obtuse θ at upper vertex, both with arcs.
spec.mathematics: sin θ / 52 = sin 34° / 36; θ is obtuse. Dark-blue edges #253F8E; black labels and angle marks. No vertex names printed.

spec.description: Inverted triangle with horizontal upper edge 4.7 km and lower vertex toward the right. Left sloping side 3 km. Interior 32° at upper-right and θ at the lower vertex, both with arcs. Preserve printed schematic shape despite the stated obtuse target.
spec.mathematics: sin θ / 4.7 = sin 32° / 3; the stem requires θ obtuse. Source drawing is not scale-accurate. Dark-blue edges #253F8E; black labels and angle marks.
